summary: Implements the entire `beep docgen quality` pipeline in one internal module: schema models for the quality report, git-based scope resolution, ts-morph exported-symbol/JSDoc subject extraction, a deterministic v1 scoring rubric, remediation-packet assembly, and JSON/Markdown report rendering. Its exports feed Docgen.command.ts, QualityWorkerEval.ts/QualityWorkerRunpodEval.ts, and the Docgen test-kit.

concerns.name: Schema domain models (report shape)
concerns.description: LiteralKit domains and S.Class models describing the quality report contract, plus three internal-only S.Class carriers and two Order instances. Pure schema-first data, no behavior.

concerns.name: Rubric/config constants
concerns.description: Version pins, required-tag lists, source globs/exclusions, and git argv constants that parameterize the whole pipeline.

concerns.name: Generic text/JSON/budget utilities
concerns.description: Command-agnostic helpers: bounded text, first-line, ISO timestamps, jsonc-formatted JSON rendering, error-message coercion, and a wall-clock runtime budget. Several are copy-pasted into sibling files.

concerns.name: Git process exec + scope resolution
concerns.description: Spawns git via effect/unstable/process ChildProcess to collect changed files and resolves the --package/--all/--changed-files/affected scope policy into workspace package targets.

concerns.name: Glob/exclude source matching
concerns.description: Hand-rolled glob-to-RegExp compiler and docgen exclude matching; globPatternToRegExp is duplicated verbatim in internal/Operations.ts:1043.

concerns.name: ts-morph JSDoc subject extraction
concerns.description: The largest seam: AST walking to find exported declarations, JSDoc/tag parsing, companion-schema/namespace detection, diagnostics capture, subject-candidate construction, content hashing, and generated-doc snippet enrichment.

concerns.name: Deterministic rubric scoring
concerns.description: Pure example-quality heuristics (regex patterns + predicates), the EXAMPLE_FINDING_RULES data catalog, and scoreSubject which folds findings into a score/tier/rationale review.

concerns.name: Aggregation + remediation-packet orchestration
concerns.description: Package report assembly, summary counting, remediation prompt/packet construction with ordering and packet-cap policy, and the two exported orchestrators analyzePackageQuality / analyzeDocgenQuality.

concerns.name: Report rendering (JSON + Markdown)
concerns.description: generateQualityJson (jsonc-formatted) and generateQualityReport (Markdown with per-subject sections and remediation packet blocks).

proposedSplit.contents: All LiteralKit domains (DocgenQualityScopeMode/ScoreMode/Tier/FindingCode/PackageStatus) and S.Class models (Finding, Diagnostic, RelatedSymbol, Subject, Review, Summary, PackageReport, RemediationPacket, Report, SubjectCandidate) plus version constants QUALITY_SCHEMA_VERSION/QUALITY_RUBRIC_VERSION and the two Order instances. Keep the existing $I path string so schema identifiers and the tracked schema catalog stay stable.

Git changed-file collection (runGitLines, collectWorkingTreeChangedFiles, collectChangedFiles, git argv constants), selectPackagesForFiles, countSelectedScopes, and the exported resolveDocgenQualityTargets.

The ts-morph extraction engine: JSDoc/tag helpers, companion-schema detection, export-candidate discovery, diagnostics capture, makeSubjectCandidate, collectModuleSubject/collectDirectExportSubjects, collectPackageSubjectCandidates, finalizeSubject, withGeneratedDocSnippets, plus glob/exclude matching (or import globPatternToRegExp from a deduped Operations helper) and the runtime-budget helpers.

Pure scoring: example heuristic regexes and predicates, EXAMPLE_FINDING_RULES catalog, exampleFindings, makeFinding/addFinding, scoreSubject, QUALITY_REQUIRED_* tag policy and missing-tag computation.

Orchestration: summarizeReviews, packageReport/emptyPackageReport, remediation prompt/packet construction with packetCandidateOrder and cap policy, and exported analyzePackageQuality + analyzeDocgenQuality (concurrency 2, timeout budget wiring).
generateQualityJson, generateQualityReport, markdownSubject, and the local renderJson/JSON_FORMAT_MAX_LENGTH until a shared renderJson exists.

Flag behavior must stay byte-identical: three same-named packet-limit flags with different defaults (25 vs defaultQualityWorkerEvalPacketLimit() vs defaultQualityWorkerRunpodEvalPacketLimit()) and two parallel flags (4 vs 1); mixing them up during extraction changes CLI defaults without type errors.

Runpod handler ordering is load-bearing: all guard validations run before Config.redacted("RUNPOD_API_KEY") and before any billable pod creation, and DomainError message strings are user-facing contract; refactoring guard chains into match/schema validation must preserve order and messages.
